kjv: supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself
mine: imagining that godliness is a means of gain
note: The KJV reverses subject and predicate (the error is treating religion as a way to make money, as 6:6 shows); TR also adds "aphistaso apo ton toiouton".

kjv: the love of money is the root of all evil
mine: the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils
note: rhiza has no article and "panton ton kakon" is plural; the KJV's "the root of all evil" makes it the single source of every evil, a stronger claim than Paul's.

kjv: oppositions of science falsely so called
mine: contradictions of what is falsely called "knowledge"
note: gnosis is knowledge (perhaps an early Gnostic claim); "science" in 1611 meant knowledge in general, but now invites a misreading about the natural sciences.
